faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026 is 24 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers positions for Confidential Assistant, Court Assistant / Additional Bailiff, and Office Attendant. There are a total of 7 vacancies across these posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired from Courts or similar government departments to be eligible for these positions. Specific qualifications are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 62 years. There are no minimum age requirements specified for retired personnel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post: Confidential Assistant will receive ₹ 24,590/-, Court Assistant / Additional Bailiff will get ₹ 23,360/-, and Office Attendant will be paid ₹ 20,280/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How will the candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list, which will be prepared considering the candidates' qualifications and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the District Court Thrissur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. Look for the links to the PDF and the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including their photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, along with the application form.
